name: Malin's Request
label: Quest
description: Skuerto gives you a sealed letter for Archmage Malin, who is found in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. It tells Malin that Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon…
intro: Skuerto gives you a sealed letter for Archmage Malin, who is found in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. It tells Malin that Kryten and Skuerto will be home soon, and Skuerto is certain Malin will repay you well for helping them in Arathi.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this letter back to Stormwind and let Malin know that Kryten an' I'll be home soon. He'll reward you well for helping us here, friend, of that I've no doubt.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes? You look vaguely familiar. I do apologize, but have we met? I get so busy I lose track.

clips.title: Completion
paras: By the Light, you've done it. How wonderful. Trelane will be so pleased. I'm sure Kryten and Skuerto are just as excited as I am to have them on their way back to Stormwind.
Thank you, friend. Please, take this to help you in your journeys.
